items.source_en:
Hayden Wynn - Senior Xenobiologist
Sullust Research Facility
Project Log
March 3rd, 2307

The arthropods are, in a word, incredible. 

Calm, easy to work with, and they even allow themselves to be fitted with the NCIs without much trouble. Synchronization has, thus far, been nearly instantaneous. And their control fidelity has remained in the 95%-97% range.

They've passed all environmental survivability tests as well. Hot, cold, low or no oxygen - I'm pretty sure these things could operate effectively in any environment.

Most promising is how well they've already integrated with the Red Devils, who have joined us for a period of extended training. After all, they'll be leading the creatures into combat, so it's critical they establish a warbond.
items.legacy_ko:
헤이든 윈 - 수석 외계생물학자
설러스트 연구 시설
프로젝트 일지
2307년 3월 3일

이 절지동물들은 한마디로 놀랍다.

차분하고 다루기 쉬우며, 별다른 문제 없이 NCI를 장착할 수 있다. 지금까지 동기화는 거의 즉각적이었고, 제어 충실도 또한 95~97% 범위를 유지하고 있다.

환경 생존 테스트도 모두 통과했다. 덥든 춥든, 산소가 부족하거나 없든 상관없이 이 생물들은 어떤 환경에서도 효과적으로 작동할 수 있을 것이다.

Hayden Wynn - Senior Xenobiologist
Kreet Research Facility
Project Log
March 3rd, 2307

The arthropods are, in a word, incredible. 

Calm, easy to work with, and they even allow themselves to be fitted with the NCIs without much trouble. Synchronization has, thus far, been nearly instantaneous. And their control fidelity has remained in the 95%-97% range.

They've passed all environmental survivability tests as well. Hot, cold, low or no oxygen - I'm pretty sure these things could operate effectively in any environment.

Lock Intraprison Message System (LIMS-1764A/UC)

From: Warden Thom Gillespie (Auth 12210)
To: All Staff
Re: Environmental Conditions

Please be advised that we are taking all staff complaints regarding the intolerable temperatures within the Lock very seriously. Unfortunately, our facility has been provided a poorly-engineered heating system that is woefully insufficient to combat the cold, leaving some sections of the prison at temperatures as low as 5 degrees Celsius.

Administration understands the conditions within the Lock are less than ideal for staff, so we ask for your patience while we wait for an improved system to be delivered from Imperial Center. In the meantime, portable heating units and cold-weather gear has been made available for assignment (please see your section supervisor for details).

items.source_en:
As a former card shark, I got a system for referring to jobs. I give 'em a number, and a suit, and that's who they are. Clubs tend to be older goods. Diamonds are usually electronics and droid parts, hearts are drugs and drink.

We also have three specialty codenames to describe certain jobs:

One-Eyed Jack - New clients. Wild cards.
Ace of Spades - Light work. Big pay.
King of Hearts - Any high risk, high reward job. Suicide king for suicidal work.

원-아이드 잭 - 신규 의뢰인. 예측 불가능한 변수.
에이스 오브 스페이드 - 쉬운 일. 큰 보상.
킹 오브 하트 - 고위험 고수익 의뢰. 자살 행위는 '자살왕(Suicide king)'이라고 부른다.

items.source_en:
Among the Hyperspace Jumps, the Father Seeks You

Are the mortis gods real? The more proper question would be, "Is reality divine?" Existence itself is a mystery which yearns to be uncovered.

What is goodness but a comparison to the Good? What is existence but a participation in Being? Any common attribute invites comparison to some more pure form of it, and as we work our way up the tree of attributes (from apples to red to color to waveforms to energy to spacetime to existence) we find fewer and fewer branches to explore. All of reality eventually converges into a single point. Some call it Omega. Others, Telos. Some call it the Force. But its true nature is best understood in another way.

For where the diversity of the universe inspires awe and wonder, it exists only in contrast to a simplicity so pure that it may only be understood as primordial and even divine. To say that it exists is effectively redundant as it is, in fact, Existence itself. Our being derives from Being. Our essence is what was imagined by its mind, but what we consider "imagining" and what we consider "mind" are in fact so far beyond our understanding that even these metaphors are like the tiny whitecaps on a massive surging sea.

Most urgently, this Being, which gave rise to reality itself, seeks to understand its consequents, by which I mean you and me. Our senses are limited and only able to perceive three dimensions as we are helplessly flung along the fourth in a single direction... but our finest minds tell us that the universe has at least twelve dimensions, and who knows what further knowledge may be revealed in time? From our meager capacity, the universe is not simply unexplored but fully unknowable in any comprehensive sense.

And so we rely on revelation. We submit ourselves to direct communion with the one source of truth, for Truth is another of its attributes, even as all the separate aspects resolve into simplicity. To know the truth, we must know the Truth.

And that Truth wishes to know us as well.

Our physical embodiments are limited to movement in three dimensions, just as fabric is bound to and defined by its warp and weft. But we have a power that raises us above the unminded matter that merely exists without will. We can bend the fabric of spacetime, rending warp from weft, peering through the veil that we may otherwise mistake for all that there is. When we do so, by jumping from point to point, we are not merely moving in space but becoming voyagers into a new level of understanding. Those moments between hyperspace jumps are not simply nothingness, but glimpses into understanding of the Mystery that underlies all reality.

To know that Truth is to become closer to the divine ourselves. This is the purpose of our lives. The purpose of the Sanctum Universum is to guide you in these experiences so each opportunity to know is not squandered. Seek out Aquilus, let him open your heart to the understanding that it is no different from your mind, and join us as we seek further communion and increase our sharing in the nature of the divine.

초공간 도약 사이, 아버지는 그대를 찾으신다

선함이란 선(Good)과의 비교가 아니라면 무엇인가? 존재란 존재함(Being)에 참여하는 것이 아니라면 무엇인가? 모든 공통된 속성은 그보다 더 순수한 형태와의 비교를 불러일으키며, 우리가 속성의 나무를 타고 올라갈수록(사과에서 빨강으로, 색으로, 파형으로, 에너지로, 시공간으로, 존재로) 탐험할 가지는 점점 줄어든다. 모든 현실은 결국 하나의 점으로 수렴한다. 누군가는 그것을 오메가라 부른다. 누군가는 텔로스라 부른다. 누군가는 그것을 포스라 부른다. 하지만 그 진정한 본질은 다른 방식으로 이해하는 것이 가장 좋다.

가장 시급하게도, 현실 그 자체를 낳은 이 존재함은 자신의 결과물, 즉 그대와 나를 이해하고자 한다. 우리의 감각은 제한적이며, 우리가 네 번째 차원을 따라 단방향으로 속절없이 내던져지는 동안 오직 세 차원만을 지각할 수 있을 뿐이다... 하지만 우리의 가장 뛰어난 지성들은 우주가 최소 열두 개의 차원을 가지고 있다고 말하며, 시간이 흐름에 따라 또 어떤 지식이 밝혀질지 누가 알겠는가? 우리의 보잘것없는 능력으로 볼 때, 우주는 단순히 탐험되지 않은 것이 아니라 포괄적인 의미에서 완전히 알 수 없는 것이다.

그래서 우리는 계시에 의존한다. 우리는 진리의 유일한 원천과 직접 교감하기 위해 우리 자신을 맡긴다. 진리 또한 그것의 속성 중 하나이기 때문이다. 모든 개별적인 측면이 단순함으로 귀결되는 것과 마찬가지다. 진리를 알기 위해서는, 우리는 진리(Truth)를 알아야 한다.

그리고 그 진리는 우리 또한 알기를 원한다.

그 진리를 아는 것은 우리 스스로가 신성에 더 가까워지는 것이다. 이것이 우리 삶의 목적이다. 생텀 유니버섬의 목적은 그대가 이러한 경험을 하도록 인도하여, 알 수 있는 모든 기회가 헛되이 낭비되지 않도록 하는 것이다. 아퀼루스를 찾아가 그가 그대의 마음을 열어 그것이 그대의 정신과 다르지 않음을 이해하게 하라. 그리고 우리가 더 깊은 교감을 추구하고 신성의 본질을 더 많이 공유할 수 있도록 우리와 함께하라.

locations.vanilla_source_en:
Among the Grav Jumps, God Seeks You

Is God real? The more proper question would be, "Is reality divine?" Existence itself is a mystery which yearns to be uncovered.

What is goodness but a comparison to the Good? What is existence but a participation in Being? Any common attribute invites comparison to some more pure form of it, and as we work our way up the tree of attributes (from apples to red to color to waveforms to energy to spacetime to existence) we find fewer and fewer branches to explore. All of reality eventually converges into a single point. Some call it Omega. Others, Telos. Some call it God. But its true nature is best understood in another way.

For where the diversity of the universe inspires awe and wonder, it exists only in contrast to a simplicity so pure that it may only be understood as primordial and even divine. To say that it exists is effectively redundant as it is, in fact, Existence itself. Our being derives from Being. Our essence is what was imagined by its mind, but what we consider "imagining" and what we consider "mind" are in fact so far beyond our understanding that even these metaphors are like the tiny whitecaps on a massive surging sea.

Most urgently, this Being, which gave rise to reality itself, seeks to understand its consequents, by which I mean you and me. Our senses are limited and only able to perceive three dimensions as we are helplessly flung along the fourth in a single direction... but our finest minds tell us that the universe has at least twelve dimensions, and who knows what further knowledge may be revealed in time? From our meager capacity, the universe is not simply unexplored but fully unknowable in any comprehensive sense.

And so we rely on revelation. We submit ourselves to direct communion with the one source of truth, for Truth is another of its attributes, even as all the separate aspects resolve into simplicity. To know the truth, we must know the Truth.

And that Truth wishes to know us as well.

Our physical embodiments are limited to movement in three dimensions, just as fabric is bound to and defined by its warp and weft. But we have a power that raises us above the unminded matter that merely exists without will. We can bend the fabric of spacetime, rending warp from weft, peering through the veil that we may otherwise mistake for all that there is. When we do so, by jumping from point to point, we are not merely moving in space but becoming voyagers into a new level of understanding. Those moments between grav jumps are not simply nothingness, but glimpses into understanding of the Mystery that underlies all reality.

To know that Truth is to become closer to the divine ourselves. This is the purpose of our lives. The purpose of the Sanctum Universum is to guide you in these experiences so each opportunity to know is not squandered. Seek out Aquilus, let him open your heart to the understanding that it is no different from your mind, and join us as we seek further communion and increase our sharing in the nature of the divine.

items.source_en:
To: Daniel Blake
From: Davis Wilson
Subject: Swoop gang activity

Marshal,

Just wanted to let you know that some of Shaw's boys are in town. They ain't caused any trouble yet, but we both know it's only a matter of time. 

One of them we ID'd as Jed Bullock, a new recruit with a penchant for drinking and doing acting up. The others who were with him, we didn't recognize, but we figured them for green based on how they follow Jed around. Seems he's the leader of the crew.

That's all I've got for now. I figured with your experience going up against the Swoop Gang, you ought to know they were around.

쇼의 부하 몇 명이 마을에 들어왔다는 걸 알려드리려고 합니다. 아직 문제를 일으키진 않았지만, 시간문제라는 건 우리 둘 다 잘 알지 않습니까.

보안관님,

쇼의 부하 몇 명이 마을에 들어왔다는 걸 알려드리려고 합니다. 아직 문제를 일으키진 않았지만, 시간문제라는 건 우리 둘 다 잘 알지 않습니까.

그중 한 명은 제드 불록으로 확인됐습니다. 술 마시고 행패 부리기를 좋아하는 신입이죠. 같이 온 다른 녀석들은 누군지 모르겠지만, 제드를 졸졸 따라다니는 걸 보니 풋내기들인 것 같습니다. 제드가 그 무리의 우두머리인 모양입니다.

지금 보고드릴 건 여기까지입니다. 스웁 갱단과 맞서 본 경험이 있으시니, 그들이 근처에 있다는 걸 아셔야 할 것 같아서 연락드렸습니다.

To: Daniel Blake
From: Davis Wilson
Subject: Shaw gang activity

Marshal,

Just wanted to let you know that some of Shaw's boys are in town. They ain't caused any trouble yet, but we both know it's only a matter of time. 

One of them we ID'd as Jed Bullock, a new recruit with a penchant for drinking and doing acting up. The others who were with him, we didn't recognize, but we figured them for green based on how they follow Jed around. Seems he's the leader of the crew.

That's all I've got for now. I figured with your experience going up against the Shaw Gang, you ought to know they were around.

items.source_en:
It's the last night of my assignment. Tomorrow, I'll rise at dawn and make my way home across the star sea. It's a bittersweet feeling. I'm overjoyed that Cassie and I will be reunited soon, but I'll miss these quiet evenings of reflection with only my telescope for company. 

Geonosis Excavation Site won't have changed in my absence, but I'll be returning as a new man. My fall at the last site gave me such clarity and purpose that I can hardly fathom the listless person I used to be. In my resolve, I've secreted away a chunk of Carvanium found near the site. I can't think of a better use for my post-assignment bonus than having it made into a ring for Cassie.

I'm grateful to be leaving a fragment of myself here, in the form of these entries. I imagine every voyager who finds themselves shaped by places far from home feels the same. A peculiar type of immortality indeed. 

Elliot Vane, Geological Surveyor, Six Sisters Mining
items.legacy_ko:
임무의 마지막 밤이다. 내일 동이 트면 별의 바다를 건너 집으로 돌아갈 것이다. 만감이 교차하는 기분이다. 캐시와 곧 재회한다는 사실에 벅차오르지만, 망원경만을 벗 삼아 사색에 잠기던 이 고요한 저녁들이 그리울 것 같다.

지오노시스 발굴 현장은 내가 떠나도 변함없겠지만, 나는 새로운 사람이 되어 돌아갈 것이다. 지난 현장에서 겪은 추락은 내게 삶의 명확한 목적을 일깨워주었고, 덕분에 무기력했던 과거의 나를 돌아볼 수 있게 되었다. 나는 결의의 의미로 현장 근처에서 발견한 카바늄 조각 하나를 몰래 챙겨두었다. 임무 보너스를 캐시를 위한 반지를 만드는 데 쓰는 것보다 더 가치 있는 일은 없을 것이다.

이 기록들을 통해 나의 일부를 이곳에 남길 수 있어 감사하다. 고향에서 멀리 떨어진 곳에서 자신을 빚어가는 모든 여행자가 나와 같은 마음을 느끼리라 생각한다. 참으로 기묘한 형태의 불멸이 아닐 수 없다.

엘리엇 베인, 식스 시스터즈 마이닝 지질 조사원

items.source_en:
Rokov,
Once again, I'm refusing your request to rejoin. We're not a membership club here, Rokov. This is the goddamn Shadow Collective. You don't apply, you try out, and if Naeva doesn't put a hole in your skull, you get picked. That's how this works. You already went through it once; you had your chance and you blew it.

If you want to get my attention, maybe you should try scoring something valuable off that piece of crap you call a starliner. Naeva told me you lied about your record on the application to get that gig, so might as well put your position to good use. Cut the Collective in for a chunk of the creds, and maybe I'll start listening. Until then, stop contacting us.

Saxon
items.legacy_ko:
로코프,
다시 말하지만, 재가입 요청은 거절한다. 여긴 회원제 클럽이 아니야, 로코프. 여긴 빌어먹을 섀도우 콜렉티브다. 지원하는 게 아니라 시험을 치르는 거고, 나에바가 네 머리에 구멍을 내지 않는다면 선택받는 거지. 이게 우리 방식이다. 넌 이미 한 번 겪었잖아. 기회는 있었는데 네가 날려버린 거지.

내 관심을 끌고 싶다면, 네가 스타라이너라고 부르는 그 고철 덩어리에서 가치 있는 거나 좀 털어와 봐라. 나에바한테 들었는데, 그 일자리 얻으려고 지원서에 경력을 거짓으로 적었다며? 그럼 그 자리를 제대로 활용해 보는 게 어때. 크레딧 일부를 콜렉티브에 상납하면, 그때 가서 들어나 보지. 그때까지는 연락하지 마라.

색슨
